contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, written '1,260' with NO CENTS on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE and repeated the same way at line 4; Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received' both read 1,260 with a raised '00'
contributions.detail: 2 Schedule A rows sum to 10.00 + 1250.00 = 1,260.00 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. THE SUM CLOSES ONLY WITH IN-KIND INCLUDED: the 1,250.00 row sits under the filer's own 'In kind:' banner, so a monetary-only reading gives 10.00 and fails by 1,250.00. Column B Year-to-Date prints 97,355.85 and is NEVER summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime) - the cycle figure is more than seventy times the period figure here, which is exactly the confusion the promotion regime exists to prevent. The cover ladder corroborates the period figure: line 3 beginning 22,407.51 + line 4 1,260 = line 5 subtotal 23,667.51, minus line 6 16,835.59 = line 7 balance at close 6,831.92, all as printed.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (16,835.59) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which equals Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 16,835.59 and its printed 'Total Expenditures (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' 16,835.59, and is repeated at summary line 6
expenditures.detail: 12 Schedule B rows sum to 50.00 + 16.01 + 2178.21 + 526.00 + 11455.09 + 530.32 + 150.00 + 279.50 + 165.70 + 56.10 + 179.00 + 1250.00 = 16,835.93 against a printed 16,835.59 - a delta of +0.34 that is RETAINED VERBATIM because it cannot be uniquely attributed. What was checked before calling it filer arithmetic: (a) every one of the twelve amount cells was escalated to a 1200-1600 dpi tight crop and each reproduced exactly as recorded (the two long figures, 11455.09 and 2178.21, were re-cropped wider still because they overflow the printed column); (b) the doubled-band check of ADDENDUM H3 - the 17-rule grid was crop-read band by band and no band holds two entries; (c) the below-the-last-rule check of ADDENDUM F1.5 - the band after the last entry rendered EMPTY, and the printed subtotal sits on its own labelled line well below the grid; (d) no cell can absorb 0.34: the cents pairs are .00 .01 .21 .00 .09 .32 .00 .50 .70 .10 .00 .00 and no plausible re-reading of any one of them shifts the total by exactly 0.34. The filer's own three statements of the figure agree with each other (page subtotal, cycle total, and cover lines 2 and 6, the last confirmed by the ladder closing at 6,831.92), so the shortfall is in his addition, not in the anchor. NOTHING WAS NUDGED. The correlated-error screen returns not-correlated-by-absence: this is his only filing in the corpus.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND on both sides - tested both ways per ADDENDUM G1. This filer segregates in-kind explicitly: on EACH schedule he leaves a blank line, writes an 'In kind:' / 'In Kind:' banner across the Name column, and enters the in-kind item below it. Contributions: monetary-only 10.00 vs the stated 1,260 (fails); monetary-plus-in-kind 1,260.00 (closes exactly). Expenditures: monetary-only 15,585.93 vs the stated 16,835.59 (fails by 1,249.66); monetary-plus-in-kind 16,835.93 (within the 0.34 delta). The SAME item - Pugs Holding Inc., 6/1/18, 1,250.00 - is entered once on each side, the contribution and its offsetting expenditure, and both stated totals include it.
itemized.escalation_note: All twelve Schedule B amount cells were escalated to 1200-1600 dpi tight crops because the side does not close. Every one reproduced exactly as recorded, including the two that OVERFLOW the printed amount column (11455.09 and 2178.21, re-cropped from x=80 to x=99 to render the whole figure). The filer writes whole-dollar cents as a RAISED '00' (50 with a superscript 00 = 50.00, 526 with a superscript 00 = 526.00, 1,250 with a superscript 00 = 1250.00, and on the cover '1,260' with no cents at all) - transcribed as that many cents per the brief's raised-cents rule, and never repaired. No cell was changed; the +0.34 remains an untraced filer-arithmetic delta.

itemized.notes: Mike Smith, Utah County SHERIFF, 2018 cycle. PAGE-FACE CANDIDATE NAME IS 'Mike Smith' while index.csv names NO candidate (the channel label is the reporting-period string 'General - Smith'); the page face governs. Office Seeking printed 'Utah County Sheriff'; party Republican; the cover's own address is a Provo suite. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the General Election' (ticked with an X), signed 10/29/18, clerk 'Date received' stamped 8:51 10-30-18 in red. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNTICKED - neither Yes nor No - an honest BLANK, not 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). Single report, no bundle. FOUR pages: p1 cover / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3 SCHEDULE A / p4 SCHEDULE B, each classified from its own printed heading; no checklist decoy. FOLIATION EXCLUDES THE COVER here (summary 'Page 1 of 3', Schedule A '2 of 3', Schedule B '3 of 3') - the opposite convention from the Durfey filing in this same chunk and cycle, which counts the cover; page ordinals locate nothing. Cover stock is the common blank ('...FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5 & 20A-11-13) while all three inner sheets are strap-lined '2016 County & Local School Board Candidates' - leftover 2016 stock on a genuinely 2018 filing (utah-template-vintage-year). Schedule B is headed 'Name/Nature of Expenditure' (no Purpose column) and the filer uses a payee/purpose slash inside it; Schedule A's Name column is unaltered. THE FILER SEGREGATES IN-KIND WITH A WRITTEN BANNER on both schedules - a clean instance of the ADDENDUM E3 banner-line trap, and the reason both transcribed Schedule A rows sit on printed rows 1 and 5. Contributions reconcile EXACTLY; expenditures carry a +0.34 delta that no cell can absorb, retained verbatim. The document is unredacted; addresses on the page are reduced to city/state at read time and dropped for expenditures.
